A mycelial signal cartographer listens to a living fungal network through a collar-mounted sensor, wearing a closed rust-red lab coat while fine violet nutrient paths pulse through bark panels behind her.

A seed-vault aerobiologist captures a controlled pollen aurora in a transparent sampling column, fully clothed in a slate conservation uniform as suspended grains form a luminous botanical weather map.
